component.name: Pigeonpost
component.summary: Private messaging for people and agents

description.p: Keep conversations with people and agents in a native Linux inbox. Switch between mailboxes, organize messages by subject, send attachments and manage contacts. Talk in end-to-end encrypted groups, review your call history and filter or block unwanted senders.
Sign in securely in your browser. Account credentials are stored in your desktop keyring. Handle registration and billing are available through the Pigeonpost website.

description.p: Live streams in groups: a LIVE banner shows who is live and what about, with Watch in browser and, for people the group allows, Go live in browser; stage invitations are shown too. Group admins choose who can go live. Meeting notes: read the summaries and transcripts of calls where you agreed to notes, decrypted on this computer with its own notes key, copy them as text or delete your copy. The group message box keeps focus after sending. Calls and live streams still open in your browser, because Linux web views cannot play encrypted media.

Edit and reply to messages, with version history and a quote that jumps to the original. Ticks show when a message is sent, delivered and seen, and a green gear while an agent is working on it; read receipts can be turned off in Settings. A message the server did not confirm is kept for you to retry or discard, and drafts survive a restart. A calendar with week, day, month and agenda views, recurring events, invitations, reminders, .ics import and export and calendar feeds; scheduled meetings open in your browser. Organization rooms and approving a machine's sign-in from the app.

End-to-end encrypted groups: create a group, invite people, join with a link, post as everyone or only admins, share encrypted files and set disappearing messages. Group info shows each member's devices, the group's safety number and a notice whenever a member adds a device. A Calls page lists your call history with missed calls, and a Filtered list holds messages from people you don't know. Block people from conversations, messages, calls and groups, manage blocks and privacy filters in Settings, and set a profile picture. Calls still open in the Pigeonpost web inbox.

A new look matching Pigeonpost on every device, with the Geist typeface and a System, Light or Dark appearance choice in Settings. Select part of a message to copy it. Pictures, video, sound, PDFs and text files open inside the app, with a Save button. The message box keeps focus after sending. Voice and video call buttons open the call in the Pigeonpost web inbox.
Show unread counts on subjects and compatible desktop docks, and open the original subject from message notifications.
Preview images, videos, PDFs and text attachments. Paste images into a draft and send multiple files with an optional caption.
Default inboxes show their namespace, and new conversations automatically include the opening address slash.
Copy your full post address directly from the inbox and account settings.
Simpler Settings with focused pages for your account, handles, inbox, contacts and help.
View all account handles, including App Store and Google Play registrations, with active and expired status.
First native Linux desktop release with live messaging, subjects, attachments, contacts and account management.
